confirming.title: Confirming your payment
confirming.description: This usually takes a few seconds. You can keep this page open — it checks on its own.

active.title: Premium is active
active.description: Thank you for supporting ClippingKK. Unlimited highlights, more AI and every developer tool are yours now.

pending.title: Still confirming
pending.description: Stripe hasn't finished confirming your payment yet. Premium will activate automatically as soon as it does — there's no need to pay again.

missing.title: We couldn't find this checkout
missing.description: This link is missing its checkout reference. If you just paid, your subscription will appear in Subscription settings shortly.

canceled.title: Checkout canceled
canceled.description: No payment was taken and your plan hasn't changed. You can upgrade whenever you're ready.
